narr: Heavy rain brought flash flooding to central Arkansas. A locally extreme rainfall event provided several inches on October 2. A few rounds of thunderstorms moved across the area bringing some beneficial rainfall to the state. While portions of northern Pulaski and Lonoke Counties picked up around 8 inches of rain, most reporting sites across the state received less than one half inch. A few exceptions included Camden (Ouachita County) where 3.00 inches of rain occurred and Newport (Jackson County) where 2.59 inches of rain fell.
ev: Rounds of heavy rain over the same area lead to flooding on Somers Avenue.
Silver Creek Drive was flooded with a vehicle almost completely submerged in the water.
Hillard Road flooded and one vehicle washed off the road. The driver was rescued.
U.S Highway 67 northbound was closed at this location due to high water across all lanes.
Sandlewood Drive was flooded with two vehicles almost completely submerged.
